title: hosts(5) — host name database

date.notes: representative BSD-descendant manual revision preserving NIC/DNS history

claims_extracted.claim: The hosts file maps addresses to official host names and aliases, was historically related to NIC-maintained host data, remains useful beside name servers, and BSD manuals trace its file format to the early 4.1c/4.2BSD networking era.
claims_extracted.notes: Exact first-BSD attribution differs across descendant manual trees; preserve revision-specific claims.

conflicts: Some descendant manuals say the hosts file format appeared in 4.1cBSD; others say 4.2BSD.
notes: Do not collapse local hosts-file lineage into the central ARPANET HOSTS.TXT distribution artifact without source-level bridging evidence.
